from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's cash amount from operating activities as reported in their financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The company's stock/security code if available")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label as written in the report")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount for the cash line item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by the report")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_records: list[CompanyCashRecord]
